services.desc: Please be aware that this page serves informational purposes, providing details about the included services and instructions on including them in your booking. To enhance and simplify your boat rental experience, we offer three optional services: Captain Hire and Fishing Package. Please read below to learn about each service and how to include them in your booking. ⚓Captain Hire It is optional to hire a captain with your boat rental. Half-Day (4 hours) Captain Hire - $200 Full-Day (8 hours) Captain Hire - $400 Instructions: Select the number one next to the "Captain Hire" option to book a Captain Hire • Fishing Package • Towable Tubes
